name: js-ts-language-plumbing
body: Add a js language id and a detector for auto-detection, plus the lang_switch control record and the id_prefix entry. The detector must not trip on node_modules (dependency JavaScript) and must not run JS and TS as separate frontends over a TS repo that also contains JavaScript — the unified frontend scans both under one language id. AC: a JS-only repo auto-detects js; a TS repo with incidental JavaScript still scans once under the unified frontend; node_modules never triggers detection.
